configuration.room: Side wing south bedroom and ensuite
limitations: Standard double with 940 mm south-side space and 835 mm north-side space; 665 mm beside the ensuite at the bed foot.
The entrance partition moves north into the family approach. The main family seating and exterior windows stay in place.
The ensuite east partition moves 350 mm west of the original layout; a 360 mm-deep basin unit keeps its aisle usable.
The hall door retains its 850 mm aperture and opens outward; the ensuite door retains 800 mm.
Wardrobe depth is 590 mm, ending clear of the retained west window and Roman blind.
